tests.name: Thermal cycling test - dielectric strength after thermal cycling
tests.description: One sample with winding of solvent-based enamelled wire replaced by metal foil or bare wire subjected to thermal cycling per 8.9.3.4, immediately followed by dielectric strength test per 8.8.3 at 1.6 times test voltage

tests.name: Humidity preconditioning - dielectric strength test
tests.description: Two samples subjected to humidity preconditioning per 5.7 for 48 hours only, followed by dielectric strength test per 8.8.3 at 1.6 times test voltage

tests.name: Temperature cycling test
tests.description: One sample containing cemented joint subjected to sequence of temperature cycling tests for 10 times

tests.name: Components and wiring
tests.description: General compliance check for components and wiring

tests.name: Component mounting security
tests.description: Components of ME EQUIPMENT likely to result in unacceptable RISK by their movements mounted securely as indicated in RISK MANAGEMENT FILE

tests.name: Conductor and connector security
tests.description: Conductors and connectors of ME EQUIPMENT adequately secured or insulated to prevent accidental detachment in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION

tests.name: Conductor breaking free - no hazardous contact
tests.description: Conductors and connectors when breaking free at their joint are not capable of touching circuit points resulting in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1

tests.name: Single fault condition - mechanical restraint
tests.description: Breaking free of one means of mechanical restraint considered a SINGLE FAULT CONDITION

tests.name: Stranded conductors - no solder coating
tests.description: Stranded conductors are not solder-coated when secured by clamping means to prevent HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS described in 13.1 due to poor contact

tests.name: Flexible cord detachable connection compliance
tests.description: Flexible cords detachable without a TOOL used to interconnect different parts of ME EQUIPMENT provided with means for connection to comply with requirements for metal ACCESSIBLE PARTS of 8.4 when connection is loosened or broken

tests.name: Cord-connected HAND-HELD parts and cord-connected foot-operated control devices
Control device voltage limits
tests.description: Control devices of ME EQUIPMENT and their connection cords contain only conductors and components operating at 42.4 V peak a.c. max or 60 V d.c. in circuits isolated from MAINS PART by two MEANS OF PROTECTION

tests.name: DC limit 60V with ripple condition
tests.description: d.c. limit of 60 V applied to d.c. with no more than 10% peak-to-peak ripple

tests.name: 42.4V peak limit for exceeded ripple
tests.description: 42.4 V peak limit applied when ripple exceeded 10% peak-to-peak limit

tests.name: Flexible cord connection and anchorage for HAND-HELD device
tests.description: Connection and anchorage at both ends of flexible cord to HAND-HELD or foot-operated control device complied with 8.11.3 when breaking free or shorting between conductors could result in HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1

tests.name: HAND-HELD parts connection disturbance
tests.description: Requirement applied to other HAND-HELD parts when disturbance or breaking of one or more connections could result in HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1

tests.name: Internal cables protection against moving parts and sharp edges
tests.description: Internal cables and wiring adequately protected against contact with a moving part or from friction at sharp corners and edges where damage to insulation could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1
tests.result_remark: Adequately protected that cannot result in hazardous situation. See Appended RM Results

tests.name: Wiring damage prevention during assembly
tests.description: Wiring, cord forms, or components are not likely to be damaged during assembly or during opening or closing of ACCESS COVERS where such damage could result in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1

tests.name: Guiding rollers bending radius
tests.description: Guiding rollers of insulated conductors prevent bending of movable insulated conductors around a radius of less than five times the outer diameter of the lead concerned in NORMAL USE

tests.name: Insulating sleeve requirements
tests.description: Insulating sleeve that can only be removed by breaking or cutting, or secured at both ends, is used on internal wiring when needed

tests.name: Flexible cord sheath as MEANS OF PROTECTION
tests.description: Sheath of a flexible cord not used as a MEANS OF PROTECTION inside ME EQUIPMENT when it is subject to mechanical or thermal stresses beyond its RATED characteristics

tests.name: Insulated conductors at high temperature
tests.description: Insulated conductors subject to temperatures > 70°C in NORMAL USE provided with insulation of heat-resistant material when compliance is likely to be impaired due to deterioration of insulation

tests.name: Electrical isolation from SUPPLY MAINS
tests.description: ME EQUIPMENT provided with means of electrically isolating its circuits from SUPPLY MAINS simultaneously on all poles

semantic_fragments.content: Winding of solvent-based enamelled wire replaced for the test by a metal foil or by a few turns of bare wire placed close to cemented joint, and three samples tested: one sample subjected to thermal cycling PROCEDURE of 8.9.3.4 and immediately after the last period at highest temperature subjected to dielectric strength test of 8.8.3 at 1.6 times the test voltage; the other two samples subjected to humidity preconditioning of 5.7 for 48 hours only followed by a dielectric strength test of 8.8.3 at 1.6 times the test voltage.

Conductors and connectors of ME EQUIPMENT adequately secured or insulated to prevent accidental detachment in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION. Conductors and connectors of ME EQUIPMENT when breaking free at their joint are not capable of touching circuit points resulting in a HAZARDOUS SITUATION described in 13.1. Breaking free of one means of mechanical restraint considered a SINGLE FAULT CONDITION. Stranded conductors are not solder-coated when secured by clamping means to prevent HAZARDOUS SITUATIONS described in 13.1 due to poor contact.

Control devices of ME EQUIPMENT and their connection cords contain only conductors and components operating at 42.4 V peak a.c., max, or 60 V d.c. in circuits isolated from MAINS PART by two MEANS OF PROTECTION. d.c. limit of 60 V applied to d.c. with no more than 10% peak-to-peak ripple. 42.4 V peak limit applied when ripple exceeded 10% peak-to-peak limit.
